# {{NAME}}

> Pay-per-call data APIs for AI agents: SEO data (keywords, SERP, competitors, search intent, AI-search demand) and, in a separate category, social media content planning for agencies and video teams (content month plan with linked dates, re-scheduling, shoot-day planning, shot lists, location check). Each call costs a small USDC amount paid with the x402 protocol. No account, no API key.

## Task guides (free to read; no payment authority)
- Worked content example (offline snapshot, no payment proof): {{BASE_URL}}/content-planning-example (German: /de/content-planung-beispiel); inputs and date-only results: {{BASE_URL}}/examples/content-case-study.json. The shift example has conflicts; do not apply it blindly.
- Website keyword demand: {{BASE_URL}}/keyword-research (German: /de/keyword-recherche)
- Local search visibility: {{BASE_URL}}/local-visibility (German: /de/lokale-sichtbarkeit)
- Content month with linked dates: {{BASE_URL}}/content-planning (German: /de/content-planung)
- Each guide includes an illustrative result and a bounded agent task. Check live availability and price, validate input and obtain explicit purchase approval.

## How to use
- MCP client setup (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor): {{BASE_URL}}/connect (German: /de/einrichten)
- Free MCP connection check script (no wallet or payment code): {{BASE_URL}}/examples/mcp-check.mjs; calls only tools/list, list_services and preflight.
- REST and MCP purchase guide: {{BASE_URL}}/quickstart.html
- Downloadable buyer example (free preview by default): {{BASE_URL}}/examples/buyer.mjs
- Free catalog with prices and limits: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/services
- OpenAPI 3.1 (with x402 price metadata): {{BASE_URL}}/openapi.json
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): {{BASE_URL}}/mcp
- Free samples (if enabled, see /api/v1/services "free_sample"): POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/free-sample/{service-id} with the same JSON body as the paid route, one per service per client per day, for single-call services up to 0.05 USDC; limited daily total. Legacy: POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/free-sample with {"keyword":"..."} (keyword-metrics, one keyword).
- Locations (free): GET {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/locations?q=rosenheim (city/region codes in Germany, Austria, Switzerland for google-serp, local-business, news-search, image-search, local-market-check; MCP tool "find_location"). Other services take country codes (2276, 2040, 2756).
- Wishlist (free, write-only): POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/wishlist with {"text":"which data tool you would pay for"}, 10 to 300 characters, 3 per day per client; MCP tool "wishlist".
- Task recipes (free, machine-readable): {{BASE_URL}}/recipes.json
- Agent card: {{BASE_URL}}/.well-known/agent.json · MCP server card: {{BASE_URL}}/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Status and trust (uptime, delivery success, how failures are handled): {{BASE_URL}}/status (German: /de/status), JSON: {{BASE_URL}}/status.json
- German homepage for humans: {{BASE_URL}}/de/
- Free input check, never charges: POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/preflight/{service-id}
- Paid calls: send the request without payment to get HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, then retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (x402 client, e.g. @x402/fetch). Network: {{NETWORK}}, asset: USDC.
- Results can be fetched again with GET {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/results/{request_id} and "Authorization: Bearer {result_token}".

## Agent Commerce
- Status of both modules (free): {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/commerce
- Agent Gift Cards: {{BASE_URL}}/giftcards — catalog, binding quote, one x402 payment of the exact quoted amount, code delivery. In preparation; endpoints answer 503 until switched on.
- Agent Finance Gateway: {{BASE_URL}}/finance — free directory of financial services payable via x402 (GET /api/v1/finance/partners, /api/v1/finance/offers). Information only: no partnership, no fees, no referral tracking.

## Notes
- Content planning services answer in German (default) or English: send "language": "en". Recipe, category and goal ids stay the same in both languages.
- For businesses only (B2B). Calling a paid endpoint means you act as a business and accept the terms of use: {{BASE_URL}}/legal.html#terms
- location_code is a country-level DataForSEO code (2840 United States, 2276 Germany, 2826 United Kingdom); the Google SERP family (google-serp, local-business, news-search, image-search, local-market-check) also takes DACH city/region codes from /api/v1/locations. Unsupported location/language pairs are rejected with HTTP 422 before any payment is requested.
- AI keyword demand values are modeled estimates, not measured prompt counts.
- Every response states data_source: "live" or "sandbox".
- MCP paid tools need an x402-capable MCP client (for example built with @x402/mcp); free tools work with any MCP client.

- Set an explicit buyer spending limit before signing. If payment or delivery is uncertain, preserve the attempt and check the original payment; never automatically create a replacement payment.
